verdict.rationale: The evidence clearly shows Weaviate is a vector database that stores and indexes vectors, accepts pre-computed embeddings, and runs vector similarity search, including as part of hybrid queries. No item mentions an approximate nearest-neighbor index or any way to configure distance metrics, so only the core similarity-search part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documentation of the ANN index type (e.g. HNSW), evidence of configurable distance metrics (cosine, dot product, L2, etc.), and independent hands-on corroboration of vector search quality.
